title: entandrophragma utile
intro: Entandrophragma utile, commonly known as African mahogany, is a tree species native to tropical Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including treating fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Entandrophragma utile are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in reducing pain and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
